mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.version FROM e_agent_price p WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.version IS NOT NULL AND p.version != '' ORDER BY p.version DESC

SELECT d.price FROM e_agent_price p INNER JOIN e_agent_price_data d ON p.id = d.en_agent_price_id WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0'
AND p.price_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.priceType}, '%')
ORDER BY d.biz_time

SELECT d.biz_time AS bizTime, d.price AS price FROM e_agent_price p INNER JOIN e_agent_price_data d ON p.id = d.en_agent_price_id WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0'
AND p.price_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.priceType}, '%')
ORDER BY d.biz_time

SELECT p.province_name AS provinceName, p.capacity_electricity_price AS capacityElectricityPrice, p.demand_electricity_price AS demandElectricityPrice FROM e_agent_price p WHERE p.del_flag = '0'
ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.user_type FROM e_agent_price p WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.user_type IS NOT NULL AND p.user_type != ''
ORDER BY p.user_type

SELECT c.source_type AS sourceType, c.source_name AS sourceName, c.source_url AS sourceUrl FROM tariff_source_config c WHERE c.enabled = 1
AND (c.province_code = #{req.provinceCode} OR c.province_code = '000000')
ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.province_code = #{req.provinceCode} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, c.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO e_fpgj_type ( id, version, province_code, province_name, second_type, create_by, create_date, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{row.id}, #{row.version}, #{row.provinceCode}, #{row.provinceName}, #{row.secondType}, #{row.createBy}, NOW(), '0' )

INSERT INTO e_fpgj_type_data ( en_fpgj_type_id, biz_time, fpgj_type, del_flag ) VALUES
( #{item.fpgjTypeId}, #{item.bizTime}, #{item.fpgjType}, '0' )

INSERT INTO e_agent_price ( id, version, province_code, province_name, second_type, third_type, dy_level, user_type, other_type, price_type, create_by, create_date, del_flag, capacity_electricity_price, demand_electricity_price ) VALUES
( #{item.id}, #{item.version}, #{item.provinceCode}, #{item.provinceName}, #{item.secondType}, #{item.thirdType}, #{item.dyLevel}, #{item.userType}, #{item.otherType}, #{item.priceType}, #{item.createBy}, NOW(), '0', #{item.capacityElectricityPrice}, #{item.demandElectricityPrice} )

INSERT INTO e_agent_price_data ( en_agent_price_id, biz_time, price, del_flag ) VALUES
( #{item.agentPriceId}, #{item.bizTime}, #{item.price}, '0' )
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS id, p.user_type AS userType, p.dy_level AS dyLevel, p.other_type AS otherType, p.price_type AS priceType, p.capacity_electricity_price AS capacityElectricityPrice, p.demand_electricity_price AS demandElectricityPrice FROM e_agent_price p WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.version = #{version} AND p.province_code = #{provinceCode} AND p.second_type = #{secondType} AND p.third_type = #{thirdType} ORDER BY p.user_type, p.other_type, p.dy_level, p.price_type, p.id

SELECT d.en_agent_price_id AS agentPriceId, d.biz_time AS bizTime, d.price AS price FROM e_agent_price p INNER JOIN e_agent_price_data d ON p.id = d.en_agent_price_id WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0' AND p.version = #{version} AND p.province_code = #{provinceCode} AND p.second_type = #{secondType} AND p.third_type = #{thirdType} ORDER BY d.en_agent_price_id, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.biz_time, ':', 1) AS UNSIGNED), CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.biz_time, ':', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
